site.author: Jinhoe
site.title: Apps – Jinhoe
site.description: Small, focused apps I build to fix little annoyances in my everyday life in Singapore.

apps.name: KongQi
apps.summary: Singapore's air quality at a glance, straight from NEA.
apps.title: KongQi – Singapore Air Quality
apps.description: Singapore's haze readings, without the clutter. The latest PSI and PM2.5 for your part of Singapore, right on your Home Screen, Lock Screen and Mac desktop.

apps.name: ZheBus
apps.summary: A simple Singapore bus arrival app with only what you need.
apps.title: ZheBus – Singapore Bus Arrivals
apps.description: Singapore bus arrivals. Simplified. Real-time timings, nearby stops and Live Activities, with no clutter.
